LESSON: WRITING 10.4.1 PUNCTUATION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Writing 10.4.1 Punctuation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 10.4.1 Punctuation, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: How do we use punctuation marks in sentences correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 10.4.1 Punctuation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn :learn independently as the learner practices using the target punctuation marks in sentences.

Values:
Unity: cooperation as the learner engages in role play in which target punctuation marks are used with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (effective communication): as the learner uses the target punctuation marks correctly.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Punctuation marks are used in texts in all learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as Hearing aids and amplifiers, charts showing punctuation marks signed audio-visual

recordings, print or digital stories, pocket charts, print and digital flash cards, wall charts, chalk board, digital or print resources
